items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the way I got into George Hudson’s band in St. Louis was that Glenn Miller had a hit record called [A String of Pearls]

ctx.x: Yeah. I wanted to listen to your thoughts. I have my [ ? ? ].

I loved what Beiderbecke played. Same as Hackett. I love Hackett. Hackett was – I knew very well, a very dear friend of mine, a beautiful player. As a matter of fact, the way I got into George Hudson’s band in St. Louis was that Glenn Miller had a hit record called [Terry sings]. What’s the name of that? [A String of Pearls]. And Hackett
had a solo on it [Terry sings the solo]. What’s the name of that? [Terry sings the theme again.] Remember that?
